purpose: End-to-end Playwright spec that verifies the sibling-forget flow: A1 authenticates (sibling-forgetter), A2 authenticates (target sibling, same bunker), B authenticates (observer, different bunker). A1 creates a group, invites B by npub; A2 is auto-invited via the same-npub multi-device flow. A1 opens Settings → Devices, clicks Forget on A2's device row, confirms. Assertions: (1) A2's leaf is absent from A1's view (AC-E2E-2, AC-E2E-11), (2) A2's leaf is absent from B's view (AC-E2E-11), (3) A1's __notestrTestForgottenSlots() hook returns A2's slot string (AC-E2E-12). No kind-5 relay assertion — sibling-forget cannot publish kind-5 from A1 because A2's KP secrets belong to A2.
dependencies_allowed: e2e/fixtures/two-party.ts (authenticate, createGroup, inviteByNpub, selectGroup, leafIndexesFor, getPubkeyHex, currentGroupId, settle)
dependencies_forbidden: e2e/fixtures/ndk-subscriber.ts (no kind-5 relay assertion for sibling-forget — Design Decision #2)
e2e/fixtures/cleanup.ts (clearAppState called internally by authenticate — never called separately)
test_targets: AC-E2E-11 (A2's leaf absent from A1's and B's member list after sibling-forget)
AC-E2E-12 (A1's __notestrTestForgottenSlots() returns array containing A2's slot string)

A1.description: Authenticates last (after B and A2) so it is admin of the group it creates. Performs the sibling-forget action on A2's device row via Settings UI.

A2.bunker: E2E_BUNKER_URL (User A — same bunker as A1)
A2.description: Authenticates second so its key package is on the relay for auto-invite. Is the target of the sibling-forget. Its leaf must be absent from all contexts after the forget.

B.description: Authenticates first so its key package is on the relay before A1 invites. Serves as external observer for the leaf-absence assertion (AC-E2E-11 second perspective).

test_sequence: beforeAll: create contextA1 + contextA2 + contextB + pageA1 + pageA2 + pageB
Step 1 (auth): authenticate(pageB, E2E_BUNKER_B_URL, 'observer') → settle(3000)
Step 2 (auth): authenticate(pageA2, E2E_BUNKER_URL, 'sibling-a2') → settle(3000)
Step 3 (auth): authenticate(pageA1, E2E_BUNKER_URL, 'sibling-a1') → settle(3000)
Step 4: capture pubkeyA = getPubkeyHex(pageA1), pubkeyB = getPubkeyHex(pageB)
Step 5: createGroup(pageA1, GROUP_NAME)
Step 6: inviteByNpub(pageA1, USER_B_NPUB) — B becomes member
Step 7: settle(pageA1, 8000) — wait for auto-invite scan to pick up A2's KP (same pubkey, different slot) and invite A2
Step 8: selectGroup(pageA2, GROUP_NAME) — A2 joins via auto-invite
Step 9: selectGroup(pageB, GROUP_NAME) — B joins via Welcome
Step 10: groupId = currentGroupId(pageA1)
Step 11: sanity assert — all three contexts in group (A1 + A2 share pubkeyA = 2 leaves; B has 1 leaf; total leaf count from pubkeyA = 2)
In core test: open Settings modal on A1 via aria-label='Settings' button
In core test: click 'Devices' tab
In core test: identify A2's device row by data-local='false' (or by slot text 'sibling-a2') and click [data-testid='device-forget-sibling-btn']
In core test: click [data-testid='device-forget-sibling-confirm-btn']
Assertion 1 (AC-E2E-2 + AC-E2E-11 from A1): expect.poll(() => leafIndexesFor(pageA1, groupId, pubkeyA)).toHaveLength(1) — A1's own leaf remains; A2's leaf is gone
Assertion 2 (AC-E2E-11 from B): expect.poll(() => leafIndexesFor(pageB, groupId, pubkeyA)).toHaveLength(1) — same expectation from B's perspective
Assertion 3 (AC-E2E-12): const slots = await pageA1.evaluate(() => window.__notestrTestForgottenSlots()); expect(slots).toContain('sibling-a2')
afterAll: close contextA1 + contextA2 + contextB

assertion_strategy.leaf_gone_from_a1: expect.poll(() => leafIndexesFor(pageA1, groupId, pubkeyA), { timeout: 30000 }).toHaveLength(1) — A1's own leaf (also pubkeyA) remains; toHaveLength(1) not 0
assertion_strategy.leaf_gone_from_b: expect.poll(() => leafIndexesFor(pageB, groupId, pubkeyA), { timeout: 30000 }).toHaveLength(1) — confirms Remove commit was accepted globally, not only locally on A1
assertion_strategy.forgotten_slot_idb: await pageA1.evaluate(() => window.__notestrTestForgottenSlots()) then expect(slots).toContain(SLOT_A2) — outer await covers Playwright serialization of the inner Promise

relay_state_independence.pinClientSlot: authenticate() calls pinClientSlot internally with the supplied slot string
relay_state_independence.clearAppState: authenticate() calls clearAppState() internally — not called separately
relay_state_independence.group_name_isolation: GROUP_NAME = `ForgetSibling ${Date.now()}` at top of describe.serial block
relay_state_independence.no_relay_resets: No e2e-down, e2e-up, or fixture-level relay reset calls
relay_state_independence.no_global_relay_assertions: All assertions scoped to test-owned pages (pageA1, pageA2, pageB)

design_decisions.no_kind5_assertion: Sibling-forget cannot publish kind-5 from A1 because A2's KP secrets belong to A2. The slot is marked locally in notestr-forgotten-slots IDB instead. This is Design Decision #2 from architecture.md.
design_decisions.leaf_count_is_1_not_0: After sibling-forget, pubkeyA has 1 leaf (A1's own) not 0. The assertion is toHaveLength(1), not toHaveLength(0).
design_decisions.a1_authenticates_last: A1 must authenticate after B and A2 so it is the most-recently-seen admin and the auto-invite scan runs from A1's context (the group creator is always the admin who can issue invites).
design_decisions.settle_before_a2_join: An 8-second settle after inviteByNpub gives the auto-invite scan time to process A2's key package and issue the invite commit, before selectGroup(pageA2) is called.
